latin: Per dictum illud Zoroastris, adhuc tres dies sacrificabitis et non ultra, apparuit mihi per arithmeticam superioris merchiaue illos computandi dies, esse in eo dicto expresse praedictum aduentum Christi.
latin_note: 'merchiaue' renders Hebrew 'merkabah'; Farmer's note glosses 'superior merkabah' as the speculative branch of the Kabbalah concerning divine things (farmer1998:25053).
translation: By that saying of Zoroaster, 'Three days more you shall sacrifice, and no longer', it became clear to me, when I counted those days by the arithmetic of the higher merkabah, that the coming of Christ is foretold in that saying in so many words.
translation_note: Sense checked against farmer1998:25073; no divergence.
